thread:
Maya K.: Quick sync — proposal to enforce strict no-egress routing for Private VPC tenants by default. If same-region capacity is exhausted, router should attempt a model-variant fallback inside allowed regions. Do we agree on fail-open vs fail-closed semantics?
Aj Patel: +1 to fallbacks but only if tenant policy explicitly allows cross-region variants. Default should be fail-closed for compliance-bound tenants.
Kai Zhang: UX idea — Console shows a "Routing Health" card per tenant: counts of fallbacks, last fallback timestamp, and a toggle to "allow regional variant fallback" with audit log.
Sasha Rivera: Important: we cannot silently route to an external egress path if tenant egress == false. Fallback must be to variants that do not break the egress constraint. If none exist, request should be denied and surfaced as policy-denied.
Lin (eng-platform): API debate: How do we surface this to callers? Option A: HTTP 200 + {"fallback":"eu-quant-v1","note":"variant used"}. Option B: HTTP 4xx with structured reason codes (e.g., 460 fallback-used, 461 policy-denied). I prefer explicit non-200 so apps can decide.
Maya K.: I worry non-200 breaks a lot of client libs expecting success for generations. Maybe keep 200 but include top-level flags: {"served_via_fallback":true, "policy_violation":false} and add telemetry.
Kai Zhang: Console/Telemetry plan: show metrics - private.routing.fallback.count, private.routing.policy.denied.count, private.routing.fallback.latency_ms (p50/p95). Also surface examples in the Deployments > Routing view.
Sasha Rivera: For audit/compliance we need a clear event in audit log whenever a fallback is used OR a request is denied due to egress. No silent conversions.
Lin (eng-platform): Sample policy YAML I'm proposing for the control plane UI (for reference):
```yaml
- tenant: "acme-corp"
  allow_egress: false
  allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1"]
  local_fallback_models: ["acme-local-quant-v1", "acme-eu-distilled-v2"]
  fallback_policy: "deny_if_no_local_variant"  # deny vs allow-cross-region
```
Maya K.: Good. Implementation notes: router needs to check (1) tenant policy, (2) local KV cache availability, (3) quantized variant pool. If step 2/3 fail, obey fallback_policy.
deploy-bot: policy apply attempt for tenant "acme-corp" returned: ERROR conflict: no local_fallback_models defined -> action=blocked
Aj Patel: Action items:
- (Aj) Add telemetry counters & docs for the three new metrics (due EOD Fri)
- (Kai) Design Console card + toggle and wire up audit event (mock by Tue)
- (Lin) Propose API surface and code mappings (200+flags vs 460/461) by Wed
- (Maya) Add router integration plan and a test matrix for fail-closed/fail-open cases (end of sprint)
Sasha Rivera: +1. Also add an integration test to assert that tenants with allow_egress: false never hit external-hosted models.
Maya K.: OK let's adopt that. We'll default to deny if no allowed local variant exists, but console will let enterprise opt into a controlled regional-fallback with explicit audit.
Kai Zhang: I'll prototype the card mock today, will post screenshots. :thumbsup:
Maya K.: Thanks everyone. We'll sync on Wed 10am to finalize API mapping.
